Cardiac Cycle Challenge

Master the heart's rhythm through hands-on learning

Part 1: Cardiac Cycle Sequencing

Instructions: Drag the phases from the bank below into the correct sequential order. When you think you have them in the right order, click "Check Sequence" to see if you're correct. If not, you can reorder the phases and try again!

Phase Names (Drag to Sequence Below)

Part 2: Pressure and Valve Position

Instructions: For each phase, identify whether atrial and ventricular pressures are increasing (↑) or decreasing (↓), and whether the AV and SL valves are open or closed. Click "Check" at the end of each row for immediate feedback. Once you've mastered each phase individually, try resetting and filling in all phases before checking your answers!

Part 2: Wiggers Diagram

Instructions: Use the Wiggers diagram below to answer questions about the cardiac cycle. Work through each step to identify the lines, valve events, and ECG components.

Step 3: Identify Volume Measurements

Boxes F and G identify volume measurements on the ventricular volume trace.
